items.statement: Unless FDA has granted a waiver of electronic submission, transmit all drug registration and listing information to FDA electronically through FDA's electronic drug registration and listing system, in a form FDA can process, review and archive.
items.quote: Except as provided in § 207.65, all information submitted under this part must be transmitted to FDA in electronic format by using our electronic drug registration and listing system, in a form that we can process, review, and archive.
items.condition: unless an electronic submission waiver applies

items.statement: Ensure registration and listing information provided electronically complies with FDA's electronic records and electronic signatures requirements, apart from the specified exemptions from certain of those controls for advertisements and labeling and for other submitted information.
items.quote: Information provided in electronic format must comply with part 11 of this chapter, except as follows:

items.statement: Provide drug establishment registration and drug listing information in English.
items.quote: Drug establishment registration and drug listing information must be provided in the English language.

items.statement: Provide the content of labeling in at least English.
items.quote: The content of labeling must be provided at a minimum in the English language.

items.statement: Where FDA rules permit product labeling solely in a foreign language, submit the content of labeling in that language together with an accurate English translation.
items.quote: Where § 201.15(c) of this chapter permits product labeling solely in a foreign language, the content of labeling must be submitted in that language along with an accurate English translation.
items.condition: where labeling solely in a foreign language is permitted

items.statement: Transmit all registration and listing information to FDA electronically unless FDA granted a waiver request before the date the information is due.
items.quote: All information submitted under this part must be transmitted to FDA electronically in accordance with § 207.61(a) unless FDA has granted a request for waiver of this requirement prior to the date on which submission of such information is due.
items.condition: unless a waiver was granted before the due date

items.statement: When requesting a waiver of electronic submission, submit the request in writing, stating the specific reasons electronic submission is not reasonable for the registrant and giving a U.S. telephone number and mailing address where FDA can contact the registrant.
items.quote: Waiver requests under this section must be submitted in writing and must include the specific reasons why electronic submission is not reasonable for the registrant and a U.S. telephone number and mailing address where FDA can contact the registrant.

items.statement: Send any electronic submission waiver request to the SPL Coordinator, U.S. Food and Drug Administration, 10903 New Hampshire Ave., Bldg. 32, Silver Spring, MD 20993.
items.quote: All waiver requests must be sent to: SPL Coordinator, U.S. Food and Drug Administration, 10903 New Hampshire Ave., Bldg. 32, Silver Spring, MD 20993.

items.statement: As a registrant subject to drug establishment registration, designate an official contact for each establishment.
items.quote: Registrants subject to the registration requirements of this part must designate an official contact for each establishment.

items.statement: Make the designated official contact responsible for ensuring registration and listing information is accurate.
items.quote: Ensuring the accuracy of registration and listing information

items.statement: Make the designated official contact responsible for reviewing, disseminating, routing and responding to all FDA communications, including emergency communications.
items.quote: Reviewing, disseminating, routing, and responding to all communications from FDA including emergency communications.

items.statement: As a registrant of a foreign establishment, designate a single United States agent.
items.quote: Registrants of foreign establishments subject to this part must designate a single United States agent.

items.statement: For a foreign establishment, ensure the United States agent resides or keeps a place of business in the United States and is not a mailbox, answering machine or service, or other place where the person acting as agent is not physically present.
items.quote: The United States agent must reside or maintain a place of business in the United States and may not be a mailbox, answering machine or service, or other place where a person acting as the United States agent is not physically present.

items.statement: For a foreign establishment, make the United States agent responsible for reviewing, disseminating, routing and responding to all FDA communications, including emergency communications.
items.quote: Reviewing, disseminating, routing, and responding to all communications from FDA including emergency communications;

items.statement: For a foreign establishment, make the United States agent responsible for answering questions about the drugs imported or offered for import into the United States.
items.quote: Responding to questions concerning those drugs that are imported or offered for import to the United States;

items.statement: For a foreign establishment, make the United States agent responsible for helping FDA schedule inspections.
